purpose: Per-source local placement instructions for donor/reference packs. These instructions tell the editor where users should place original zips/sheets before running safe dry-run bake checks. They do not authorize runtime use by themselves.

rules.rawAssets: remain user-supplied or quarantined unless a project decision explicitly allows otherwise
rules.blockedSources: may be visible for learning/reference but must not be baked into runtime
rules.dryRunOnly: placement instructions feed the dry-run availability report; actual bake/promote remains a later explicit step
